description: React component for creating and submitting a volunteer opportunity with multi-step form, image upload, and preview features.

methods.name: AddVolunteer
methods.description: Main React component for adding a volunteer opportunity with multi-step form, image upload, and preview.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Handles input change events to update form data state.

methods.name: handleDateChange
methods.description: Updates date fields in form data state.

methods.name: handleAddSkill
methods.description: Adds a new skill to the skillsRequired array if not already present.

methods.name: handleRemoveSkill
methods.description: Removes a skill from the skillsRequired array.

methods.name: uploadToImgBB
methods.description: Uploads an image file to imgbb API and returns the image URL.

methods.name: handleImageUpload
methods.description: Validates and uploads an image, updating preview and form data.

methods.name: nextStep
methods.description: Validates current step and advances to the next step.

methods.name: prevStep
methods.description: Goes back to the previous step.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Validates form data and submits the volunteer post, then resets form on success.
